name: What does a 'turnkey' tiny home build mean?

mainEntity.name: What does a 'turnkey' tiny home build mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: A turnkey tiny home build means that the construction firm handles every aspect of the project from start to finish, delivering a ready-to-live-in home. This typically includes design, permitting assistance, foundation work, construction, interior finishes, and utility connections. Clients can move in immediately upon completion without needing to manage multiple contractors or significant post-build tasks. It simplifies the process for homeowners, offering a single point of contact and responsibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: A turnkey build means your tiny home is delivered completely finished and ready for move-in, with the construction firm managing all aspects from design to final touches.
